gloss: to be absorbed in reading; to read avidly

definitions.gloss: to be absorbed in reading; to be engrossed in a book
definitions.explanation: To become so focused on reading that one loses track of time or forgets about one's surroundings.

examples.japanese: {小説|しょうせつ}に{読|よ}みふけった。
examples.english: I was absorbed in a novel.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}で{漫画|まんが}に{読|よ}みふけっていた。
examples.english: I was engrossed in manga at the library.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}おそくまで{推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}に{読|よ}みふけって、{気|き}がつけば{朝|あさ}になっていた。
examples.english: I got so engrossed in a mystery novel late at night that before I knew it, it was morning.

notes:
{読|よ}みふける is an intransitive ichidan verb. Compound of {読|よ}み (reading) + ふける (to be absorbed in). The auxiliary ふける attaches to other verb stems as well (e.g., {考|かんが}えにふける, {物思|ものおも}いにふける).

ASPECT (ている):
{読|よ}みふけっている describes the ongoing state of being absorbed in reading.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- {本|ほん}に{読|よ}みふける (to be engrossed in a book)
- {小説|しょうせつ}に{読|よ}みふける (to be absorbed in a novel)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小説|しょうせつ}に{読|よ}みふける (to be lost in a novel)
- {本|ほん}に{読|よ}みふける (to be absorbed in a book)
- {一日中|いちにちじゅう}{読|よ}みふける (to read all day long)
